paragraphs: The Defender P300e is the plug-in hybrid variant of the L663-generation Defender, combining the Ingenium AJ200P 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor. It's been part of the Defender range since the L663 generation launched, offering a petrol hybrid powertrain alongside the diesel and mild-hybrid options. Unlike the diesel and MHEV variants, the P300e does not share the DC-DC converter failure pattern that affects some mild-hybrid Ingenium engines — the PHEV electrical system is separate hardware and has not been identified with the same issue. The petrol engine itself shares the same Ingenium four-cylinder family as the P300, with a broadly similar rebuild pattern.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200P engines for every Defender P300e on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol unit fitted to the Defender P300e (and other L663 petrol variants). Part of the Ingenium engine family shared across JLR's modern range. No Defender-specific issue confirmed for this application. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ200P rebuild. Check Your AJ200P Defender P300e → [link to quote form] Note: PHEV-specific components (electric motor, battery, charging system) are not part of the engine rebuild scope. Our rebuild covers the petrol engine only — we can advise separately on PHEV ancillaries.

compatibility.intro: Because the Defender P300e uses a specific PHEV drivetrain configuration, fitting a replacement from a non-hybrid P300 is not straightforward — the electric motor integration, wiring harness and ECU calibration differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ200P) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
